title: Two-dimensional Hyperbolic RNN Neural Quantum State
summary: In the first part of this work, we construct the first type of two-dimensional (2D) hyperbolic neural quantum state (NQS) in the form of the Lorentz 2DRNN (Recurrent Neural Network) and benchmark its performance against the Euclidean 2DRNN in the paradigmatic $N \times N$ 2D Transverse Field Ising Model (2DTFIM) setting with different lattice sizes up to N = 12 at different transverse magnetic field strengths.
